# Session 2

## 2. Radio Dimensioning {.theory-slide}

::: {.theory-card}
### Main topics

- Coverage, capacity, and spectrum.
- Simplified link budget.
- Spectral efficiency.
- Sub-6 GHz versus mmWave.
- Cell sizing and radio node count.
- Trade-offs between coverage and densification.
:::

## 2. Radio Dimensioning: Use Case {.use-case-slide}

::: {.use-case-card}
### Example prompt

Dimension radio access for an industrial campus with high reliability and a city center with peak-hour congestion.

### Expected student task

- Estimate required spectrum.
- Size the number of radio nodes.
- Justify the chosen band.
- Discuss the coverage-capacity trade-off.
:::
